# Prompt library

Prompts that work well with NDL PubSec MCP, grouped by what you want to do. Replace anything in angle brackets.

NDL PubSec MCP is an independent prototype. It is not a government service and is not endorsed by any government department.

## Check a record before it goes out

For: Catalogue publisher, Data champion. Tool: `metadata_validate`.

```text
Check this Dataset record against xGov MEM and list anything I must fix before I publish it: <paste the record>
```

Check it: Each finding names the attribute path. Fix the errors; consider the warnings.

## What data moves when someone dies?

For: Analyst or researcher, Policy or product colleague. Tool: `exchange_search`.

```text
Using exchange_search, show the data exchanges behind registering and reporting a death: who is told, what moves, which identifiers join it, the legal basis and sources. Then list what still relies on email or paper.
```

Check it: Each exchange names its sources and a provenance label. Read the source before relying on it; S means found through search.

## Catch a misspelt attribute

For: Catalogue publisher, Metadata or standards lead. Tool: `metadata_validate`.

```text
Validate this record and tell me if any attribute names are not in the model: <paste the record>
```

Check it: Look for an unknown attribute and a missing one with a similar name together: that pair usually means a spelling difference.

## Spot a value outside the allowed list

For: Catalogue publisher, Metadata or standards lead. Tool: `metadata_validate`.

```text
Check this record and, for any value outside the model's list, show me the allowed values: <paste the record>
```

Check it: Choose one of the allowed values exactly as written, including capital letters.

## What could connect UK Export Finance and HMRC?

For: Analyst or researcher, Developer or AI builder, Metadata or standards lead. Tool: `api_search`.

```text
Find HMRC APIs that could help an export finance team check an exporter's VAT and EORI numbers and size a market for a product. For each, give the documentation link, how access works, and whether it is in the government API catalogue.
```

Check it: Open each documentation link before relying on it. Customs declarations about a named trader are not open APIs: they need a legal gateway and a data-sharing agreement.

## Find data on a topic

For: Analyst or researcher, Policy or product colleague. Tool: `catalogue_search`.

```text
Search data.gov.uk for road traffic counts. Show the ten most relevant results as a table with title, publisher, licence, formats and last updated, and give me each catalogue link.
```

Check it: Results change as the catalogue changes, so none are shown here. Open the catalogue link before you rely on a result.

## See how ready a catalogue entry is for xGov MEM

For: Catalogue publisher, Metadata or standards lead, Analyst or researcher. Tool: `dataset_describe`.

```text
Describe the data.gov.uk dataset <name or id> and list the xGov MEM attributes its record still lacks, required ones first.
```

Check it: Missing attributes are reported as missing, never guessed. Compare with the real-record sample on this page.

## Explain a standard to a colleague

For: Policy or product colleague, Data champion, Metadata or standards lead. Tool: `standard_explain`.

```text
Explain Open Referral UK in plain English: what it is for, its status, its licence and where to read it. Tell me how sure you are of each fact.
```

Check it: Each answer carries a provenance label and a check date. Anything not verified at the primary source should be re-read there.

## Check whether a business term is certified

For: Metadata or standards lead, Policy or product colleague. Tool: `term_lookup`.

```text
Look up the term 'crosswalk'. Who drafted it, what review level has it passed, and is it certified?
```

Check it: A term counts as certified only when it is endorsed after review at level H2 or above. Anything unrecorded is reported as unknown.

## Find tools that work alongside this one

For: Developer or AI builder, Contributor or co-designer. Tool: `domain_list`.

```text
List the MCP servers that work alongside this one, what each is for, and where each manifest came from.
```

Check it: This server lists the others but never calls them. Each entry names the repository and commit its manifest came from.

## Find an MCP server for UK legislation

For: Developer or AI builder, Contributor or co-designer. Tool: `server_search`.

```text
Which MCP servers could I use alongside this one for UK legislation? Tell me each one's status and where it was checked.
```

Check it: Candidates are listed for review only and are not endorsed. Read each server's own documentation and safety statement before connecting it.

## Tips

- Press / anywhere on the page to search or ask a question in plain English.
- Name the tool in your prompt when you need a specific one.
- Ask for a table with the catalogue link in every row, so each answer can be checked.
- Ask the assistant to say how sure it is, and which tool each fact came from.
- Use api_search to check whether an API already exists before you build or buy one.
- Use organisation, limit and offset with catalogue_search to page through one publisher's records.
